i01.q: What makes TCS door entry systems special?
i01.a: TCS offers modular, durable systems for all building types – from single-family homes to large-scale projects. All products are manufactured in Germany and stand out for their high quality and easy installation.

i02.q: Which building types are TCS systems suitable for?
i02.a: TCS systems are suitable for single-family homes, multi-family buildings, commercial properties, public institutions and large-scale objects.

i03.q: Are the systems suitable for elderly people?
i03.a: Yes, TCS systems offer intuitive operation, large displays and optionally accessible features.

i04.q: Are the systems suitable for renovations / existing buildings?
i04.a: Yes, the 2-wire systems in particular are very well suited for use in existing buildings.

i05.q: What does “plug and play” mean for TCS products?
i05.a: Pre-configured systems that are ready to use immediately without complex programming.

i06.a: TCS provides a comprehensive manufacturer warranty on all products. Details are available via the warranty check.

i07.q: What is the difference between Senso Pro and Tasta Pro?
i07.a: Senso Pro features capacitive touch buttons, Tasta Pro mechanical bell pushes. Both series are available in audio and video variants.

i08.a: A compact DECT module that enables door communication via existing DECT telephones.

i09.q: Is there an app for door communication?
i09.a: Yes, with snipdoo door calls can be forwarded to the smartphone and the door can be opened via the app.

i10.q: Which door opener types are suitable for the TCS:BUS system?
i10.a: Standard door openers with 12 V AC/DC or electric locks can be controlled directly.

i11.q: At what height should video stations be mounted?
i11.a: The recommended mounting height for video outdoor stations is approx. 1.50 m (centre of camera).

i12.q: How many stations can be connected to a TCS:BUS system?
i12.a: Depending on the control unit, up to 200+ subscribers can be connected.

i13.q: Which cable lengths are permitted on the TCS:BUS?
i13.a: Depending on the cable cross-section, line lengths of up to several hundred metres are possible.

i14.a: Yes, all TCS:BUS devices are reverse-polarity protected, which makes installation particularly convenient.

i15.q: Can video be retrofitted in existing systems?
i15.a: Yes, with video 2-wire technology (V2D), video can be retrofitted via existing 2-wire lines.

i16.a: A technology that enables video transmission over just two wires – ideal for retrofits.

i17.q: Does TCS offer access control systems?
i17.a: Yes, the BCM system provides comprehensive digital access control with transponders, PIN codes and smartphone access.

i18.a: Transponder cards, key fobs, PIN code, fingerprint and smartphone (BLE/NFC).

i19.a: snipdoo is the cloud-based TCS solution for door communication via smartphone – with video, door opening and push notifications.

i20.q: Can snipdoo be retrofitted into existing systems?
i20.a: Yes, snipdoo can easily be integrated into existing TCS systems via a gateway.

i21.q: Where do I find spare parts?
i21.a: Spare parts are available via the TCS24 online shop.

i22.q: How can I submit a warranty request?
i22.a: Via the RMA form or the online warranty check at garantie.tcsapps.de.

i23.a: Yes, our technical support is available by phone and email.

glossar.headline: Terms & abbreviations
glossar.intro: Briefly explained – from A to Z.

automatischeWahl.def: Automatic connection to a predefined station when the handset is picked up.

aktoren.def: Components that convert electrical signals into mechanical actions – e.g. door openers or relays.

automatischeTueroeffnung.def: Automatic opening of the door after a call is answered, without an additional key press.

bussystem.def: Shared communication line that connects all devices of a door entry system (e.g. TCS:BUS).

busspannung.def: Operating voltage on the bus line, typically approx. 24 VDC for TCS systems.

datenprotokoll.def: Defined communication rules for data exchange between bus participants.

dinSchiene.def: Standardised mounting rail for power supplies, control units and modules in distribution cabinets.

tuerruf.def: Signal transmission from the bell push at the outdoor station to the indoor station.

etagenruf.def: Call from a floor door (not the main entrance) to the indoor station.

vollduplex.def: Speaking and listening at the same time – like a normal telephone call.

schaltplan.def: Technical drawing of the electrical wiring of a door entry system.

seriennummer.def: Unique identification number of each TCS device for service and warranty.

kurzschlussschutz.def: Property of a device to remain undamaged in the event of a short circuit.

transformator.def: Power supply for converting the mains voltage to the operating voltage of the system.

verdrahtungsplan.def: Simplified schematic representation of the system wiring.

winClip.def: TCS-proprietary modular clip system for tool-free mounting of indoor stations.

faq.headline: Frequent technical questions
faq.intro: Answers on installation, wiring and configuration.

i01.q: The system whistles – what should be checked?
i01.a: Check the cable lengths, the distance between outdoor and indoor station and the volume setting. Too small a distance or incorrect wiring can cause feedback.

i02.q: Which voltages can be measured at the BVS20 control unit?
i02.a: The bus voltage of approx. 24 VDC is present at the BVS20. During active communication, signal voltages can be measured on the bus line.

i03.a: Yes, all TCS:BUS devices are reverse-polarity protected, which makes installation particularly convenient.

i04.q: Which cable lengths are permitted on the TCS:BUS?
i04.a: Depending on the cable cross-section, line lengths of up to several hundred metres are possible. Details can be found in the respective datasheets.

i05.a: Configo is the programming and configuration software for TCS systems. It enables convenient setup and adjustment of all system parameters.

i06.q: What can the TCS service device do?
i06.a: The service device is used for diagnostics, programming and troubleshooting on TCS:BUS systems directly on site.

i07.q: How do you set up call forwarding?
i07.a: Call forwarding is configured via the indoor station or the snipdoo app. Door calls can be forwarded to smartphones or other stations.

i08.q: Can video be retrofitted in existing systems?
i08.a: Yes, with video 2-wire technology (V2D), video can be retrofitted via existing 2-wire lines.

i09.q: How can I have my service device activated?
i09.a: Activation is handled by TCS customer service. Please contact us with the serial number of your device.

i10.q: How can I have the Configo (FBI) software activated?
i10.a: Send a request with your customer number and the hardware ID to TCS support.
